accounts.browser_login_msg:
Log in with your {what} {who} account in the browser window that opened.
This closes by itself when you're done.

accounts.guide:
Account is who you log in as. It doesn't have to own the channel: to moderate someone else's chat, type their channel. On Twitch, what needs the owner's login (channel points, bits, polls) is left out.
Changing the channel starts a clean chat and community for it; the old ones come back if you type it again.

accounts.spotify.help: Spotify Premium is required. Create an app in the Spotify developer dashboard, add http://127.0.0.1:45564/callback as a redirect URI, select Web API, and paste the client ID below. Add your Spotify account under User Management if needed.

spotify.template_about: Viewers request songs for your Spotify queue with !sr, and use !song, !queue, !remove and !skip. Who can request, the limits and the replies are the group's settings. Streamerz only.

settings.about.tagline: A light stream automation app, made in Rust.
settings.autostart.about_linux: Run Streamerz when you log in.
settings.memory.saver.about: Applies after restart. Designed for background use.
settings.memory.effects: No chat history, Community tracking, credits, avatars or emote catalogs.
settings.memory.first_words: First Words stays enabled using temporary disk storage.
settings.memory.files: Existing Community files stay untouched. Commands and connections stay enabled.
settings.chat.fade_in.about: How long a new line takes to appear. 0 shows it at once.
settings.chat.fade_out.about: How long a line takes to go when its time is up. 0 takes it away at once.
settings.chat.keep_history.about: Keep recent messages in memory so you can read and send chat. Turning this off reduces memory use; commands and triggers still run.
settings.chat.keep_history.memory_saver: Memory Saver keeps chat history off until you restart with it disabled.
settings.chat.lifetime.about: A line goes from the chat, and from memory, this long after it was said. 0 keeps them.
settings.chat.moved.about: How many lines the chat keeps, for how long, and how they fade. They're on the Chat page too, under Options.
settings.chat.per_platform.about: The most lines each platform's chat keeps in memory (10 to 1000). The oldest go first.
settings.chat.total.about: The most lines all the chats keep together (10 to 1000). The oldest go first.
settings.dates.about: How lists, history and the chat show a day.
settings.debug_log.about: Also log details for tracking down a problem.
settings.instance_name.about: What tools connected to the WebSocket server see this as.
settings.language.about: The language of the app: the system's by default, English when the system's isn't here. Applies the next time Streamerz starts.
settings.start_hidden.about: Open in the tray; click its icon for this window.
settings.theme.about: Follow the system (dark or light, and its accent colour), or pick one.
settings.times.about: 12 or 24 hours, for chat lines and history.

accounts.tiktok_sending.login_needed: Log in to TikTok in your browser
accounts.tiktok_sending.no_browser: No Chrome, Edge, Brave, Chromium, Vivaldi or Opera found. Install one, or load the extension by hand from the folder Copy path copies.
accounts.tiktok_sending.step_connect: 3. The extension connects to Streamerz (by itself).
accounts.tiktok_sending.step_load: 2. In {browser}, enable Developer mode, click Load unpacked, then paste the folder (Ctrl+L, Ctrl+V).
accounts.tiktok_sending.step_login: 4. Sign in only if TikTok asks. Your existing login is reused.
accounts.tiktok_sending.step_login_done: 4. Logged in to TikTok as @{user}. You can close this.
accounts.tiktok_sending.step_open: 1. Click Set up next to the browser you use TikTok in.
accounts.tiktok_sending.step_open_done: 1. {browser} opened the setup tab, and the folder is copied.
accounts.tiktok_sending.page_lead: The extension folder is already copied. This tab closes itself once the extension connects.
accounts.tiktok_sending.page_step_open: 1. Open {browser}'s extensions page from the browser menu (Extensions > Manage Extensions), or copy this address into a new tab:
accounts.tiktok_sending.page_step_load: 2. Turn on Developer mode, click Load unpacked, then paste the extension folder (Ctrl+L, Ctrl+V).
accounts.tiktok_sending.why: TikTok requires a secure helper extension in your browser to send chat messages with your account. Keep your browser open in the background while streaming so Streamerz can deliver your messages.
accounts.tiktok_sending.browser_closed: Browser is closed. Keep your browser open in the background to send TikTok chat.
accounts.tiktok_sending.outdated_warning: Update available: Extension v{installed} is connected, but v{latest} is ready. If you previously loaded an older extension folder manually in your browser, please reload or remove the old extension in your browser extensions page.
accounts.tiktok_sending.complete_version: TikTok is ready (Extension v{version}). You can close setup.
find.tiktok_login: Log in through Accounts > TikTok > Set up first.
chat.tiktok_empty: Type a message to send to TikTok.
chat.tiktok_too_long: TikTok messages can have up to 150 characters, including the @mention. Shorten your message.
chat.tiktok_stickers_unavailable: TikTok stickers cannot be sent yet. Choose an emoji or type a message.
settings.animations.about: Dialogs, menus and panels slide and fade in and out. Off: they appear at once.
twitch.error.owner_only: Only the channel owner's login can do this on Twitch.
twitch.error.scope: Your Twitch login doesn't allow this yet: log in again in Accounts to give permission.
twitch.error.login: Twitch didn't accept the login: log in again in Accounts.
twitch.error.affiliate: Twitch allows this only for Affiliate and Partner channels.
twitch.error.busy: Twitch asks to slow down: try again in a minute.
twitch.error.down: Twitch is having trouble right now: try again soon.
twitch.error.forbidden: Twitch says this account can't do that here.
twitch.error.no_login: Log in to Twitch in Accounts first.
twitch.error.not_found: Twitch couldn't find it (it may have ended).
automation.gift_id_error: Choose a detected gift or enter its numeric ID. Leave it blank for any gift.
automation.coin_error: Coin bounds must be whole numbers, zero or greater.
automation.coin_range_error: Maximum coins must be zero (no limit), or at least the minimum.
automation.completed_hint: Completed means no execution error was reported. It does not confirm delivery when a service gives no receipt.
automation.delivery_error: Choose every gift update or gift/combo completion.
automation.duration_error: Enter a valid duration such as 10s, 5m or 1:30. Second-based settings need a whole number of seconds.
automation.template_gifts_about: An editable thank-you for completed TikTok gifts and combos. Starts disabled so you can choose the gift and reply first.
automation.template_gifts_setup: Choose a gift in the action trigger, edit Reply in group settings, then enable the action. TikTok sending needs its browser account.
automation.template_reward_about: A Twitch reward shows an OBS source for a chosen duration. Starts disabled until you choose the reward, scene and source.
automation.template_reward_setup: Select a reward in the trigger. Set Scene, Source and Visible for in group settings, then enable the action. Uses the first connected OBS connection. Queued runs happen in order.
